subject: Marketplace staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request (CloudWay)
thread_summary: CloudWay requests a temporary staging entitlement and an exception to allow their systems integrator (GammaSI) to onboard ahead of full Marketplace listing. Internal thread triages product entitlements, security evidence (SOC2), commercial trade-offs, and an SI exception scope. Outcome: agree on sandbox-only entitlement with rate caps, require SOC2 snapshot/contract addendum, sales to propose short-term credit, and engineering approves SI access under constrained API keys and audit hooks.
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@cloudway.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. CloudWay is moving to a pilot with a handful of enterprise prospects and we need two things to keep momentum:

1) Temporary staging entitlement on Redwood Marketplace so our product and SI partner can validate end-to-end flows before the formal listing. We only need a sandbox quota for ~6 weeks.
2) An exception to allow our systems integrator (GammaSI) to onboard and run integration tests from their environment (they will use our customer accounts during the pilot).

I've attached a proposed "staging entitlement matrix" with approximate QPS and token ceilings. Our procurement lead is copied. Can we get an internal runbook of what needs to be signed and any security evidence required?

Appreciate any path to speed this up — our pilot kickoff is target week of Jul 10.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Partnerships, CloudWay
attachments: staging-entitlement-matrix.xlsx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@cloudway.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-30T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request

Hi Sarah — thanks for the matrix, looks reasonable as a first pass. Looping in Laura (product), Ben (sales), and Marissa (partner ops) to triage. A few quick questions so we can scope the exception without blocking your timeline:

- Is GammaSI onboarding to CloudWay-managed customer accounts or to their own SI sandbox? This affects account-level access.
- Do you have a recent SOC2 / security snapshot we can reference? If you can share a link that speeds review.
- Are you requesting API keys with full production quotas or restricted sandbox keys?

Our internal goal will be to propose a constrained "sandbox-only" entitlement and a short-term SI exception with audit hooks and rate caps. Karthik — can you weigh in on technical constraints for SI access?

I'll draft a one-page exception playbook once we confirm the above.

Cheers,
Connor
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request

Quick product take: happy to support a limited sandbox entitlement with these constraints:

- Duration: 6 weeks max with automatic expiry unless extended by formal Marketplace listing.
- Scope: sandbox model variants only (no access to production-dedicated capacity), token ceiling of 5M tokens/week, request QPS cap at 10 r/s.
- SI access: ephemeral API keys issued to GammaSI tied to CloudWay pilot accounts, keys scoped to sandbox endpoints + restricted telemetry (read-only logs for debugging).

We will need CloudWay/Procurement to sign a short addendum covering the SI access and to acknowledge audit logging. For security, upload a SOC2 snapshot or a vendor security questionnaire.

I can draft the entitlement config and an addendum template — Marissa, can you own the ops checklist?

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Product Management

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request

From a commercial perspective, to move quickly I'm ok with a short-term concession: offer CloudWay a 25% credit for the first 6 weeks of sandbox usage in exchange for fast-tracked onboarding and a mutual case study if pilot converts. Will need finance OK but seems doable.

I'll take point on the commercial note; Marissa/Connor coordinate timing with procurement.

—Ben
VP, Strategic Accounts

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@cloudway.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-02T10:46:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request

Sarah — circling back with our internal plan and next steps. Summary below (internal details omitted for this thread):

- Redwood can provide a sandbox-only entitlement for 6 weeks with token and QPS caps as in your matrix.
- SI access (GammaSI) can be allowed under ephemeral keys limited to sandbox endpoints; keys will be audit-logged.
- We require a SOC2 snapshot or vendor security questionnaire and a signed addendum acknowledging the SI scope.
- Sales is prepared to offer a short credit for the initial period to offset risk.

Attachments: staging-entitlement-matrix.xlsx (we updated a few caps) and a draft SI onboarding checklist (si-onboarding-checklist.md).

Can you confirm you can: 1) provide SOC2 snapshot link, 2) confirm GammaSI will use ephemeral keys and their principal contact, and 3) accept the 6-week sandbox window?

Once you confirm, Marissa will schedule a 30-minute handoff to onboard GammaSI. Targeting onboarding week of Jul 10.

Thanks,
Connor

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@cloudway.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudway.ai>, GammaSI Integrations <devops@gammasi.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request

Thanks, Connor — good plan. Quick notes:

- SOC2: we have a current SOC2 Type II report; here's a pointer: https://cloudway.ai/soc2-snapshot (we'll also send a redacted PDF through your vendor intake).
- GammaSI will run tests from their own environment but will act against CloudWay pilot accounts. Their lead is Priya Mehta (cc removed for privacy in this export).
- Procurement: we can accept a sandbox window and the addendum. Please send the addendum; procurement wants billing terms clarified (Net30 / project billing).

We appreciate the credit offer — please include proposed language and amount. We're aiming for Jul 10 kickoff as well.

Best,
Sarah

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-07T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging entitlements + SI onboarding exception request

Technical sign-off and constraints from infra:

- We can provision ephemeral sandbox API keys scoped to CloudWay pilot accounts. Keys will expire after 6 weeks and can be revoked at any time.
- Enforce per-key QPS of 10 r/s and token ceiling of 5M tokens/week via routing policy.
- Audit hooks: SI requests will be tagged with a partner_id and a "si_onboard" flag so that product telemetry can filter and we can retain separate logs for 90 days.
- GammaSI will not be granted access to Dedicated pools or customer-managed keys.

Action items assigned:
- Marissa: open the onboarding runbook and schedule the Jul 10 handoff with GammaSI.
- Connor/Ben: finalize commercial credit amount and procurement language (Net30).
- Laura: prepare the entitlement config and addendum draft.
- Connor: request CloudWay upload redacted SOC2 PDF to our vendor intake link (sent).

If those tasks are completed this week, infra will provision keys on Jul 9 for a Jul 10 start.

—Karthik
Senior Engineer, Serving Runtime
